observations: Photo 0 shows a Nikon-branded box/carton with large printed text that includes “D750”. A camera body with a lens is also visible on top of the box.
Photo 1 shows an open Nikon package with manuals/leaflets visible; the camera body itself is not clearly shown.
Photo 2 shows the inside of a shipping box with items wrapped in bubble wrap; no clear model number or camera body details are readable.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 box text shows “D750” and Nikon branding.
No close-up of the camera body condition (scratches, sensor cover, buttons, screen) is shown.
No powered-on test, shutter count, autofocus check, or screen/controls demo is shown.

claims.claim: We have the model is D850.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 box text shows “D750”, not D850.

risks.risk: Model mismatch: seller says D850 but photos show D750 on the box; wrong model affects price and compatibility.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera’s model marking (e.g., on the front/bottom plate) or the EXIF/system info screen after powering on.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case shown/most certain from photos: Nikon D750 body (not D850).

risks.risk: “Body” claim may be misleading: photos show a lens mounted on the camera in photo 0, so it may not be body-only.
risks.proof: A photo showing what’s included laid out (camera body, lens model, caps, battery, charger) or a close-up of the lens mount area and lens model text.
risks.if_unproven: Price as body-only (no lens) unless inclusion is proven.

risks.risk: Not actually working (shutter, autofocus, buttons, battery/charger, SD slot, ports).
risks.proof: Short video: power on → menu visible → take a photo → playback on screen; also show autofocus on a nearby object.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / assume faults until proven working.

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible: sensor dust/fog, screen cracks, worn rubber grips, corrosion from moisture.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: rear LCD, top dials, lens mount, and a test shot of a blank wall/sky to reveal sensor dust.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible cosmetic wear and potential sensor dust.

risks.proof: Photo of all accessories included with labels (battery model, charger, cables, strap, manuals).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming missing at least one key accessory (e.g., charger or battery) until confirmed.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the camera model marking on the body (or a powered-on screen showing model).
Show what’s included: camera body + lens (if any) with lens model, battery, charger, strap, and all accessories laid out.
Power-on test video: menu visible, autofocus test, shutter actuation, and a playback image.
Close-ups: rear LCD, top dials, lens mount, and a sensor dust test shot (blank wall/sky).
response.reason: The photos strongly indicate Nikon D750 (box text), while the seller text claims D850—this is a key pricing mismatch. Also, “working perfectly” and “body-only” are not verifiable from the provided images, so the safest next step is to request decisive proof before pricing.
